'''András Recski''' ({{IPA|hu|ˈrɛt͡ʃki ˈɒndraːʃ|lang}}; born 21 April 1948) is a [[Hungary|Hungarian]] [[mathematician]] working in [[matroid theory]] and [[combinatorial optimization]], and especially in their applications to the theory of [[Electrical network|electric networks]] and to [[Structural rigidity|rigidity]] in [[statics]]. He is professor emeritus at the [[Budapest University of Technology and Economics]] (BME), where he headed the Department of Computer Science and Information Theory from 1990 to 2011, and a [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor]] of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="itf">{{cite web |title=Recski András |work=iTF Adattár |url=https://itf.njszt.hu/szemely/recski-andras/ |publisher=Neumann János Számítógép-tudományi Társaság, Informatikatörténeti Fórum |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref name="mta">{{cite web |title=Recski András |work=Köztestületi tagok |url=https://mta.hu/koztestuleti_tagok?PersonId=9952 |publisher=[[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref> He was secretary-general of the [[János Bolyai Mathematical Society]] from 2006 to 2015.<ref name="itf"/>

== Education ==
Recski was born in [[Budapest]] on 21 April 1948. He studied mathematics at [[Eötvös Loránd University]], graduating in 1971, and obtained the university doctorate (dr. rer. nat.) in 1973.<ref name="cv">{{cite web |title=Recski András szakmai önéletrajza |date=2006-02-28 |url=https://doktori.math.bme.hu/recski.pdf |publisher=Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Doctoral School of Mathematics and Computer Science |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref>  In 1977 he received the degree of [[Candidate of Sciences]] from the Hungarian Academy of Sciences for the dissertation ''Matroidok és villamos hálózatok'' ("Matroids and electric networks", 1976), supervised by [[Vera T. Sós]] and [[László Lovász]],<ref>{{cite book |last1=N. Abaffy |first1=Csilla |last2=Tőzsér |first2=Ágnes |title=Kandidátusi és doktori disszertációk (1975. február 1 – 1979. december 31.) |series=A Magyar Tudományos Akadémia Könyvtára Kézirattárának Katalógusai |volume=12 |publisher=Library of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences |location=Budapest |year=1981 |issn=0541-9492 |isbn=((963-7301-38-7)) |at=entry D 7119 |url=https://library.hungaricana.hu/hu/view/MTAKonyvtarKiadvanyai_KEZIRATKAT_12/ |language=hu}}</ref> and in 1984 the degree of [[Doctor of Sciences|Doctor of the Mathematical Sciences]], for the dissertation ''Matroidok és alkalmazásaik lineáris hálózatok kvalitatív vizsgálatában'' ("Matroids and their applications in the qualitative analysis of linear networks", 1983).<ref>{{cite book |last=Horányi |first=Károly |title=Kandidátusi és doktori disszertációk (1980. január 1 – 1984. december 31.) (D 8271 – D 10.847) |series=A Magyar Tudományos Akadémia Könyvtára Kézirattárának Katalógusai |volume=19 |publisher=Library of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences |location=Budapest |year=1988 |issn=0541-9492 |isbn=963-7302-41-7 |at=entry D 10 470 |url=https://library.hungaricana.hu/hu/view/MTAKonyvtarKiadvanyai_KEZIRATKAT_19/ |language=hu}}</ref><ref name="cv"/><ref name="mta"/><ref name="mgp">{{MathGenealogy|id=73538}}</ref>

== Career ==
From 1971 to 1984 Recski was a researcher at the Research Institute for Telecommunication (Távközlési Kutató Intézet, TKI) in Budapest, while also lecturing at Eötvös Loránd University from 1972. In 1984 he became a founding member of the university's new Department of Computer Science and was appointed professor there in 1988.<ref name="cv"/><ref name="itf"/><ref name="bss">{{cite AV media |title=A Professzor – Recski András |series=A Professzor |type=Video interview |others=Interviewer: Ákos Oláh; director: Géza Pál Anda |publisher=Budavári Schönherz Stúdió |date=2015-02-14 |url=https://bsstudio.hu/video/a-professzor-recski-andras |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Lovász László |work=iTF Adattár |url=https://itf.njszt.hu/szemely/lovasz-laszlo |publisher=Neumann János Számítógép-tudományi Társaság, Informatikatörténeti Fórum |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref>

In 1990 he moved to the Budapest University of Technology and Economics (BME) to head the Department of Mathematics of the Faculty of Electrical Engineering, while retaining a part-time professorship at Eötvös Loránd University.<ref name="szit">{{cite web |title=A tanszék profilja és története |url=https://www.cs.bme.hu/rolunk/profil.html |publisher=Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Department of Computer Science and Information Theory |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref name="bss"/> He headed the department (later renamed Department of Computer Science and Information Theory) from 1990 until 2011.<ref>{{cite book |editor-last=Vajta |editor-first=László |title=A Villamosmérnöki és Informatikai Kar története 1949–2009 |publisher=Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Informatics |year=2009 |url=https://vik.bme.hu/document/5338/original/1_VIKT%C3%96RT%C3%89NET-100907.pdf |language=hu |page=134}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Az intézet története |url=https://math.bme.hu/intezet-tortenete |publisher=Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Institute of Mathematics |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref name="itf"/><ref name="szit"/><ref name="ait">{{cite web |title=Faculty |url=https://cs.ait-budapest.com/ait-people/faculty |publisher=[[Aquincum Institute of Technology]] |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref> He was succeeded as head by his former doctoral student [[Gyula Y. Katona]] and became professor emeritus in 2017.<ref name="itf"/><ref name="szit"/><ref name="mgp"/>

Since 2009 Recski has been the academic director of the [[Aquincum Institute of Technology]].<ref name="itf"/><ref name="ait"/>

Recski is the co-author of three Hungarian-language university textbooks used as course texts at several Hungarian universities: ''A számítástudomány alapjai'' ("Foundations of computer science"), ''Rendszeroptimalizálás'' ("Systems optimization") and the problem collection ''Gráfelméleti feladatok'' ("Problems in graph theory").<ref>{{cite web |title=Recski András |url=https://www.typotex.hu/author/155/recski_andras |publisher=Typotex Kiadó |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |last1=Friedl |first1=Katalin |last2=Recski |first2=András |last3=Simonyi |first3=Gábor |title=Gráfelméleti feladatok |series=Az informatika elmélete |publisher=Typotex |location=Budapest |year=2006 |language=hu |url=https://www.typotex.hu/latex/recski.pdf |at=Front matter and preface}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Véges matematika |url=http://heger.web.elte.hu/21221vm.html |publisher=Eötvös Loránd University |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Mérnökinformatikus BSc – tantárgyleírások |url=https://gamf.uni-neumann.hu/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/Mernokinformatikus_BSc_2017_Tantargyleirasok_Levelezo.pdf |publisher=John von Neumann University, GAMF Faculty |year=2017 |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Optimalizálás a gyakorlatban számítógéppel – tantárgyi program |url=https://semmelweis.hu/dei/files/2020/09/Optimaliz%C3%A1l%C3%A1s-a-gyakorlatban-sz%C3%A1m%C3%ADt%C3%B3g%C3%A9ppel.pdf |publisher=Semmelweis University |year=2020 |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Kombinatorika gyakorlat |url=https://www.math.u-szeged.hu/~ngaba/kombi_gy-15-2/index.html |publisher=University of Szeged |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref>

He was secretary-general of the [[János Bolyai Mathematical Society]] from 2006 to 2015, and was vice-chair of the Mathematics Committee of the Hungarian Academy of Sciences from 1999 to 2005.<ref name="cv"/><ref name="itf"/>

== Research ==
Recski's research concerns [[matroid]] theory and combinatorial optimization and their use in engineering, in particular in the analysis of [[Electrical network|electric networks]], in the design of [[Very Large Scale Integration|VLSI]] circuits, and in the [[Structural rigidity|rigidity]] of bar-and-joint and [[tensegrity]] frameworks.<ref name="cv"/><ref name="bme">{{cite web |title=Dr. Andras Recski |work=BME Competence Map |url=https://competence.bme.hu/researchers/144-dr-andras-recski/ |publisher=Budapest University of Technology and Economics |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref>

In 1981 he conjectured that a generalization of the [[matroid parity problem]] can be solved in polynomial time. The conjecture was proved by Jácint Szabó in 2008, using Lovász's linear matroid parity algorithm and a technique on jump systems due to [[András Sebő]], with applications to rigidity and to the unique solvability of linear networks.<ref name="szabo">{{cite journal |last=Szabó |first=Jácint |title=Matroid parity and jump systems: a solution to a conjecture of Recski |journal=[[SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics]] |volume=22 |issue=3 |year=2008 |pages=854–860 |doi=10.1137/07068494X}}</ref> In 1982, he conjectured that the union of graphic matroids, if it is not itself graphic, is never binary. The conjecture remains open in general, and he has returned to it in joint work with his doctoral student Csongor Csehi.<ref>{{cite conference |last=Recski |first=András |title=Some open problems of matroid theory, suggested by its applications |book-title=Matroid Theory (Szeged, 1982) |series=Colloquia Mathematica Societatis János Bolyai |volume=40 |publisher=North-Holland |year=1985 |pages=311–325}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |last1=Csehi |first1=Csongor Gy. |last2=Recski |first2=András |title=The graphicity of the union of graphic matroids |journal=[[European Journal of Combinatorics]] |volume=50 |year=2015 |pages=38–47 |doi=10.1016/j.ejc.2015.03.022}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Csehi Csongor György: Graphicity of the union of matroids |work=Országos Doktori Tanács |url=https://doktori.hu/index.php?lang=HU&menuid=193&vid=18299 |language=hu |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref> He co-edited with Lovász the proceedings of that colloquium, the first of the society's international colloquia devoted entirely to matroid theory.<ref>{{cite book |editor1-last=Lovász |editor1-first=László |editor2-last=Recski |editor2-first=András |title=Matroid Theory |series=Colloquia Mathematica Societatis János Bolyai |volume=40 |publisher=North-Holland |location=Amsterdam |year=1985 |isbn=978-0-444-87580-8}}</ref>

His 1989 monograph ''Matroid Theory and its Applications in Electric Network Theory and in Statics'' has been described as the most comprehensive treatment of the applications of matroid theory available.<ref name="zbl">{{cite web |title=Review of Matroid theory and its applications in electric network theory and in statics by András Recski |work=[[zbMATH Open]] |id={{Zbl|0723.05023}} |url=https://zbmath.org/0723.05023 |access-date=2026-08-22}}</ref><ref name="zamm">{{cite journal |last=Bräsel |first=H. |title=Recski, A., Matroid Theory and its Applications in Electric Network Theory and in Statics |type=Review |journal=[[Zeitschrift für Angewandte Mathematik und Mechanik|ZAMM]] |volume=72 |issue=3 |year=1992 |doi=10.1002/zamm.19920720321}}</ref> More recently he has worked on the classification and synthesis of linear [[Two-port network|multiports]].<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Recski |first1=András |last2=Vékássy |first2=Áron |title=Interconnection, Reciprocity and a Hierarchical Classification of Generalized Multiports |journal=[[IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems|IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems I: Regular Papers]] |volume=68 |issue=9 |year=2021 |pages=3682–3692}}</ref>
